page_title: G13 Haze Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the G13 Haze marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-dominant Hybrid
Breeder: Barney’s Farm
Genetics: G13 × Hawaiian Haze
THC Content: ~20–24%
CBD Content: Low
Terpene Profile: Limonene , Myrcene , Caryophyllene
Flowering Time (Indoor): 9–10 weeks
Harvest Time (Outdoor): Mid October
Yield (Indoor): ~500–600 g/m²
Yield (Outdoor): Moderate to High
Plant Height: Medium to Tall
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Among modern haze hybrids, G13 Haze occupies a distinctive place due to its combination of legendary genetics and energetic sativa expression . Created by the renowned breeders at Barney’s Farm, the cultivar merges the mysterious potency associated with G13 with the bright, tropical influence of Hawaiian Haze. The result is a plant that balances cerebral stimulation with physical warmth, producing a complex experience that appeals to both seasoned cannabis enthusiasts and curious newcomers seeking a refined daytime weed strain .

Rather than delivering a simple rush of stimulation, this hybrid unfolds gradually. The early moments often bring mental clarity and creative focus, while later stages reveal a mellow body relaxation that prevents the energetic head effects from feeling overwhelming. With its layered terpene profile, substantial potency, and distinctive cultivation traits, G13 Haze has established itself as a notable entry in the world of haze-dominant hybrids.
Genetics and Lineage

Understanding the appeal of this cultivar requires examining the two influential parents that shaped its character. The first component, G13, carries one of the most mythologized reputations in cannabis history. While its origins are frequently debated, the line is widely associated with powerful indica traits —dense buds, substantial resin production, and deep physical relaxation. Breeders have long prized G13 for its potency and its ability to strengthen hybrid vigor in crossbreeding projects.

The second parent, Hawaiian Haze, contributes the bright sativa qualities that define the hybrid’s personality. This tropical haze variety is celebrated for its uplifting mental effects and aromatic complexity. Aromas often include citrus, sweet fruit, and herbal spice, traits that carry forward into many haze-based crosses. Hawaiian Haze also introduces structural characteristics typical of equatorial sativas, including longer branching and vigorous vertical growth.

Barney’s Farm selected these two parents to produce a balanced hybrid that maintains haze brightness while grounding it with physical depth. The resulting plant expresses a clear sativa dominance in effect and structure, but the influence of G13 helps moderate the sometimes chaotic intensity of traditional haze lines. As a result, the hybrid delivers clarity and stimulation without the jittery or overly racy sensation sometimes associated with pure sativas .
Effects and Experience

The experience typically begins with a noticeable shift in mental energy. Shortly after consumption, many users describe an increase in alertness and attentional focus. Ideas appear to flow more freely, making the strain popular among artists, writers, and individuals seeking creative momentum. Conversations may become more engaging as the mind becomes more verbally expressive and responsive to new stimuli.

As the cerebral component develops, a gentle physical sensation begins to emerge. Rather than heavy sedation, the body experiences a gradual release of tension. Muscles loosen and minor physical discomfort may fade into the background. This physical component is subtle but important—it provides balance and prevents the mental stimulation from becoming overly intense.

Later stages of the experience often introduce a calm, contented mood that softens the initial burst of energy. The hybrid’s terpene combination contributes to this transition, allowing the effects to taper into a relaxed state while maintaining mental clarity. For many consumers, this progression makes the strain suitable for daytime or early evening use when productivity and mood elevation are desired without sacrificing physical comfort.
Medical Benefits

Patients exploring cannabis for therapeutic purposes often appreciate the balanced profile this cultivar provides. Its energizing mental qualities may assist individuals dealing with fatigue or low motivation. Because the initial effects stimulate alertness and focus, the strain is sometimes selected by those seeking a clearer mental state during daytime activities.

Mood regulation represents another common reason for its use. The uplifting head effects frequently coincide with a reduction in negative thought patterns, potentially offering temporary relief for individuals experiencing stress or mild depressive symptoms . The mental clarity associated with haze genetics can also encourage a sense of optimism or engagement with daily tasks.

At the same time, the G13 lineage introduces physical comfort that may benefit individuals dealing with minor aches or muscular tension. While the hybrid is not typically considered a heavy analgesic strain, its relaxing body component can ease discomfort without inducing deep sedation. For some patients, this balance makes it particularly appealing when relief is needed without sacrificing functional mobility.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The sensory profile of this hybrid reflects the complex terpene chemistry inherited from its haze lineage. When the flower is first broken apart, a burst of citrus and herbal fragrance tends to dominate the aroma. Bright lemon zest notes mingle with subtle tropical fruit undertones, creating a scent that immediately signals its sativa heritage.

Closer inspection often reveals deeper layers of spice and earthiness contributed by the G13 side of the family. These elements introduce a grounding warmth to the aroma, preventing it from becoming purely sweet or fruity. Caryophyllene contributes a peppery note, while myrcene provides a faint earthy base that supports the brighter citrus elements.

During consumption, the flavor profile mirrors the aromatic complexity. The first inhale typically presents citrus and herbal notes, followed by a slightly sweet tropical taste reminiscent of pineapple or mango. On the exhale, subtle spice and woody undertones linger on the palate. This layered flavor progression is one reason many enthusiasts consider the cultivar particularly enjoyable when vaporized, as terpene nuances become more pronounced.
Growing Information

Cultivators who work with this hybrid often notice its strong sativa growth tendencies. Plants tend to develop a tall, branching structure with multiple lateral shoots extending from the central stem. Because of this growth pattern, training techniques such as topping, low-stress training, or screen-of-green methods can help manage height and encourage more uniform canopy development.

Indoor flowering typically completes within nine to ten weeks, though some growers allow slightly longer maturation to maximize terpene expression. During this stage, dense resin production becomes evident as trichomes accumulate across the buds and surrounding leaves. The flowers themselves often display a bright green coloration accented by vibrant orange pistils.

Environmental control is particularly important when cultivating haze-dominant hybrids. Adequate airflow helps prevent moisture buildup in the elongated colas, and consistent lighting encourages even bud development. When grown under optimal conditions , yields can reach impressive levels due to the plant’s vigorous branching and strong flower production.

Outdoor cultivation is also possible in warm climates with long growing seasons. In these environments, plants may reach substantial heights and produce expansive canopies. Growers often support branches during late flowering as the weight of resinous buds increases.
FAQ
What kind of strain is G13 Haze? It is a sativa-dominant hybrid created by crossing G13 with Hawaiian Haze. The strain combines energetic mental effects with moderate physical relaxation.
How strong is G13 Haze? THC levels commonly range between 20% and 24%, placing it in the higher potency category. Its effects are typically clear and uplifting rather than overwhelmingly sedating.

Is G13 Haze good for daytime use? Many consumers prefer it during the daytime because the initial effects promote alertness, focus, and creativity. The gentle body relaxation later in the experience helps maintain comfort without heavy fatigue.

What does G13 Haze taste like? The flavor often includes citrus zest, tropical fruit sweetness, herbal haze notes, and subtle spice. Terpinolene and limonene contribute much of the bright aromatic character.

Is G13 Haze easy to grow? The plant is moderately challenging due to its sativa structure and vigorous growth. Growers who manage height with training techniques and maintain stable environmental conditions often achieve strong yields.
Final Thoughts on G13 Haze

Within the diverse landscape of modern cannabis genetics , this hybrid stands out as a thoughtful fusion of legendary potency and vibrant haze energy. By combining the physical depth associated with G13 and the uplifting spirit of Hawaiian Haze, Barney’s Farm created a cultivar capable of delivering both stimulation and comfort in a single experience.

For enthusiasts seeking an energetic yet balanced strain, the plant offers a compelling option. Its layered terpene profile produces an aromatic experience rich with citrus, tropical fruit, and warm spice, while the effects unfold in a progression that encourages creativity, sociability, and relaxation.

Cultivators also appreciate the hybrid for its vigorous growth and generous yields when properly managed. Although its sativa structure requires attention to training and environmental conditions, the reward often arrives in the form of resin-covered buds and vibrant terpene expression.

Whether explored for its flavor, its stimulating mental qualities, or its intriguing genetic lineage, G13 Haze continues to maintain a respected position among haze-dominant hybrids. For many cannabis enthusiasts, it represents the ideal intersection of classic genetics and modern breeding refinement.
